missing_acceptance_binding: No ProofStory acceptance binding maps the snapshot acceptanceClaim to checklist/verificationIntent refs. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_red_evidence: Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

touchpoint_uncovered: docs/requirements/decisions/source-lineage-dedup-playbook-seed-promotion-execution-plan.md is not covered by the files field of any checklist item (please add this path to the corresponding item's files.modify/create/test or explicitly exclude it via excludes)

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. `scope_check_save` already exists; a lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must persist the result through `scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
